section.heading: Notice.

para.text: When a motion to establish a SOUL Family is filed, the Family Court shall promptly set a time for an adjudicatory hearing and shall cause notice thereof to be given to all parties.
The Family Court shall direct the issuance to, and personal service upon, the youth's parents of a summons and a copy of the motion to establish a SOUL Family.
When it is appropriate to the proper disposition of the case, the Family Court may direct the service of a summons upon other persons.
If personal service under this section cannot be effected, notice shall be made constructively pursuant to rules of the Superior Court of the District of Columbia.

section.codify:annotation: Applicability of D.C. Law 26-159: § 4 of D.C. Law 26-159 provided that the creation of this section by § 2(c) of D.C. Law 26-159 is subject to the inclusion of the law’s fiscal effect in an approved budget and financial plan. Therefore that amendment has not been implemented.
